verdict.rationale: Sentry's 'Cron Monitoring' feature only tracks the health/heartbeat of jobs scheduled elsewhere; there is no evidence Sentry itself lets an AI-native user create, schedule, or orchestrate recurring jobs or workflows. The MCP server and CLI evidence show querying/managing issues, not workflow scheduling. Missing for 10: any documentation of a scheduler/workflow engine, recurring task creation via API/MCP, or automated remediation job scheduling.
